local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local goal=nil;local path=nil;local node=1;local approaching=true;local timer=0
local function planar(a,b) local d=a-b;return math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y) end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<.1 then return end;timer=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died approaching original right-entry chair')
 assert(self.cell.name=='ChorrolCastleGreatHall','Wrong cell for original chair baseline')
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 local stool=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x03fdce))
 assert(stool and stool:isValid(),'Original placed right chair unavailable')
 local target
 if approaching then
  if not goal then
   local desired=stool.position+stool.rotation:apply(util.vector3(100,0,-44))
   goal=nearby.findNearestNavMeshPosition(desired,{{agentBounds=types.Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self),includeFlags=nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.Walk+nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.UsePathgrid,searchAreaHalfExtents=util.vector3(150,150,250)}})
   if not goal then print('RightSeat awaiting navmesh');return end
  end
  if planar(self.position,goal)<45 then approaching=false;print('RightSeat approach reached');return end
  if not path then
   local status,points=nearby.findPath(self.position,goal,{{agentBounds=types.Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self),includeFlags=nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.Walk+nearby.NAVIGATOR_FLAGS.UsePathgrid,destinationTolerance=20}})
   print('RightSeat path status='..tostring(status)..' nodes='..#points)
   if status~=nearby.FIND_PATH_STATUS.Success or #points<2 then return end
   path=points;node=1
  end
  while node<=#path and planar(self.position,path[node])<28 do node=node+1 end
  target=path[node] or goal
 else
  target=stool.position+util.vector3(0,0,25)
  local origin=camera.getPosition();local view=camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5))
  local hit=nearby.castRay(origin,origin+view*2000,{{ignore=self}})
  if hit.hitObject==stool and hit.hitPos and (hit.hitPos-origin):length()<143 then print('RightSeat focused original in range');print('RightSeat ready-to-step') end
 end
 local d=target-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0))
 local angle=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local pitch=camera.getPitch()
 if not approaching then local v=target-camera.getPosition();pitch=-math.atan2(v.z,math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y)) end
 if math.abs(angle)<.02 and (approaching or math.abs(pitch-camera.getPitch())<.02) then print('RightSeat ready-to-step') end
 print(string.format('RightSeat aim x=%d y=%d node=%d pos=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f distance=%.2f',math.max(-200,math.min(200,math.floor(angle*512+.5))),math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*512+.5))),node,self.position.x,self.position.y,self.position.z,d:length()))
end}}}}
